mapper.sql: h.SALE_ID, l.SALE_LINE_ID, h.SALE_NO, TO_CHAR(h.BUSINESS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BUSINESS_DATE, h.PARTNER_ID, h.PARTNER_NAME, h.WAREHOUSE_ID, h.WAREHOUSE_NAME, h.ASSIGNEE_ID, h.ASSIGNEE_NAME, h.PROGRESS_STATUS, h.NOTE AS HEADER_NOTE, l.ITEM_ID, i.ITEM_CODE, l.ITEM_NAME, l.SPECIFICATION, l.UNIT, l.QUANTITY, l.UNIT_PRICE, l.SUPPLY_AMOUNT, l.VAT_AMOUNT, l.TOTAL_AMOUNT, l.NOTE
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM SALE h JOIN SALE_LINE l ON l.SALE_ID = h.SALE_ID LEFT JOIN ITEM i ON i.ITEM_ID = l.ITEM_ID
ORDER BY h.BUSINESS_DATE ASC, h.SALE_ID ASC, l.SALE_LINE_ID ASC
